device.name: Pi Pico W stepper rotation axis (stepper_controller.PicoStepperController)

facts.text: The controller speaks a text protocol: commands end with a newline and replies start with OK:, ERROR: or STATUS:
A command is written as '<command>\n' and one reply line is read
SPEED_RPS sets the target speed in revolutions per second and accepts negative values for reverse
RAMP sets the acceleration/deceleration rate in steps/sec^2
STOP ramps the motor down to zero speed
ENABLE enables the stepper driver and DISABLE disables it (the docstring says it cuts power)
STATUS returns (current_rps, target_rps, position in steps), or None when the reply cannot be parsed
The example firmware defines 200 steps per revolution
The example firmware sets the AccelStepper maximum speed to 10000 steps/s
The example firmware starts with a ramp rate of 10 steps/sec^2
The README says to match the microstepping, baudrate and library configuration to the user's stepper/driver hardware
The README presents the GUI rotation speed range as the user's own limits ('Change to your limits')
The README says the emergency procedure is to click the GUI EMERGENCY STOP ALL button and, if needed, to turn the power off physically
